what_it_is: One month-of-year index learned from ALL products and years (e.g. median of product ratios, shrunk toward 1 by years of data), applied to MA3/TSB bins; or let every bin use a model that already has month_of_year
evidence_from_this_audit: Shared month shocks = 11-13% of scaled error variance (shuffle null max 1.8%), p3_common_month_shocks.csv; company-total MA3 miss repeats one year later r = 0.57, p = 0.004, 23 month pairs 2024-04..2026-02 (p3_portfolio_month_effect.csv); removing month_of_year from XGBoost costs +2.8 pts (eebd741); crude company factor Q4: +5.0 pts worse with 1 year behind it, -1.4 pts [-3.7, +0.9] with 1-2 years (tie)
expected_effect_on_product_wape: small to moderate (up to about 1.6-1.8 pts if all of the shared month shock were captured: 1 - sqrt(1 - 0.114..0.132) of a 26.9% WAPE); grows as years accrue
